elements.text:
Open your inventory and look just above the off-hand (shield) slot: there sits a small /bcharm button/z. Click it and your worn magic is laid out; click it again and your armour returns exactly as it was.

  With it open, three slots stand above the button. Nearest is the /bRing slot/z, for magic rings. Above that the /bTalisman slot/z, for necklaces and worn charms. Topmost is the /bCharm slot/z, which takes all wearable charms.

  Where your armour was, four /bgarment slots/z appear: /bCrown/z, /bBody/z, /bBelt/z and /bGrimoire/z.

  The /bBelt/z carries a all types of bags and pouches. The /bGrimoire/z slot holds any magic book or tome. Etc. Every slot answers its own key.
